Game Overview

Fishing with Three Rods is a fishing title where experience the thrill of the catch as you juggle three rods in this angling adventure. Reel in a variety of fish, dig for bait, and aim to unlock all achievements. Feel the excitement of being a true fisherman with each tug on your line!

How to Play

Getting started in Fishing with Three Rods doesn't take long to learn. Experience the thrill of the catch as you juggle three rods in this angling adventure. Reel in a variety of fish, dig for bait, and aim to unlock all achievements. Feel the excitement of being a true fisherman with each tug on your line!
